name: Summerberry Farm
description: In 430 Rimer Road, NC, Summerberry Farm raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Blackberries, Apples, and Corn on a independent farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
